questions.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
questions.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: The healthier seedlings caused the gardeners to provide shade.
Shade provided by the gardeners reduced the seedlings' exposure to heat.
The seedlings protected the gardeners from the heat.
The heat was reduced because the seedlings dried out.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: healthier seedlings caused...把结果当成原先行动的原因；seedlings protected gardeners交换了保护者与被保护者；heat was reduced because...反转因果，还把减少高温暴露偷换成降低环境温度。

questions.target: 段落限定 / 一般影响 vs 人为干预成效
questions.q: One paragraph says recommendation algorithms exert enormous influence on what users click. The last paragraph says attempts by regulators to steer those algorithms through a simple disclosure rule are 'far less certain' to work. If a question asks about the effect of the intervention in the last paragraph, which description fits best?
o: profound
questionable
desirable
harmless

exp.trans: 前一段说推荐算法对点击行为影响很大；最后一段却说监管者仅靠披露规则来引导算法是否有效，远没有那么确定。若题干限定最后一段的人为干预，其成效应是“存疑的”。
exp.structure: 第一句评价algorithm influence；第二句把对象切到attempts by regulators，并用far less certain限定能否奏效。
exp.other: intervention 干预；regulator 监管者；disclosure 披露；steer 引导。
exp.meaning: “影响本身很强”不等于“人为操控这种影响的策略有效”。题干有in the last paragraph时，必须服从局部段落的评价对象。
exp.rest: profound可概括前段influence，却不对应末段对干预成效的怀疑；desirable/harmless都没有末段证据。

questions.skill: with + 名词 + 后置成分
questions.q:
The bakery opened at six, with warm bread cooling on the counter.
with 后面的结构主要起什么作用？
o: 补充开门时伴随的状态
引出老板的直接引语
说明开门的唯一目的
充当opened的直接宾语

exp.trans: 面包店六点开门，当时温热的面包正在柜台上晾凉。
exp.structure: 主干：The bakery（主语）+ opened（不及物谓语）+ at six（时间状语）。原始简单句Warm bread was cooling on the counter → 去掉was，用with引出：with warm bread cooling on the counter。warm bread是with结构的逻辑主语，cooling是与之构成主动关系的现在分词。
exp.other: bakery 面包店；cool 晾凉、变凉；counter 柜台；warm 温热的。
exp.meaning: with复合结构可以补充主句发生时的伴随状态；它不是新的独立主句。
exp.rest: 直接引语通常由say等动词引出，此处没有任何说话行为。目的常用to do或in order to，原句只描写伴随状态。opened在本句是不及物用法，with短语不是其直接宾语。

questions.q: The scientist's office was surprisingly ___: plain shelves, an old desk, and no awards on display.
o: unpretentious
unpredictable
formidable
perplexing

diag.1: 把 unpretentious 和 unpredictable 混淆了：这里描述的是朴素、不摆架子的风格，不是“无法预测”。
diag.2: formidable 表示“令人敬畏的、难对付的”，与 plain / no awards 的语义方向相反。
diag.3: perplexing 表示“令人困惑的”，这里没有“难以理解”的线索。

exp.trans: 这位科学家的办公室出人意料地朴素：普通的书架、一张旧书桌，而且没有陈列任何奖项。
exp.structure: 主干：The scientist's office（主语）+ was（系动词）+ unpretentious（表语）。冒号后 plain shelves, an old desk, and no awards on display 是对“朴素”的具体说明。
exp.other: plain 普通的/朴素的；shelf 书架；on display 陈列着；award 奖项。
exp.meaning: unpretentious = 不装腔作势的、朴实低调的。注意：unpredictable 才是“无法预测的”。
exp.rest: unpredictable = 无法预测的；formidable = 令人敬畏的/难对付的；perplexing = 令人困惑的。这道题只有 unpretentious（朴素、不摆架子）与后面的普通书架、旧桌子、不展示奖项一致。

questions.q: The committee spent twenty minutes arguing about the font on the warning sign, while the real issue was whether the bridge was safe. They were clearly ___.
o: missing the point
making a point
reaching the point
pointing out

diag.1: make a point 常表示“提出观点/特意强调”，这里强调的是没抓住真正问题。
diag.2: reach the point 需要具体语境，如 reach the point where...，不能表达“没抓住重点”。
diag.3: point out 通常后接宾语，表示“指出”；这里既不合结构也不合语义。

exp.trans: 委员会花了二十分钟争论警示牌的字体，而真正的问题是这座桥是否安全。他们显然没有抓住重点。
exp.structure: 第一句：The committee（主语）+ spent（谓语）+ twenty minutes（宾语）；arguing...说明时间花在何事上。while连接对比；whether the bridge was safe作表语从句。第二句：They（主语）+ were missing（现在进行时谓语）+ the point（宾语）。
exp.other: committee 委员会；warning sign 警示牌；issue 问题/争议点；safe 安全的。
exp.meaning: miss the point = 没抓住重点、没理解关键。point 在这里是“要点/关键”，不是“节点”。
exp.rest: make a point = 提出/强调观点；reach the point = 达到某个阶段/程度；point out = 指出某事。只有 missing the point（没抓住重点）符合他们纠结字体却忽视桥梁安全的语境。

questions.target: 并列信息 / 主语对象
questions.skill: 正确选项可对应并列句一侧
questions.q: A critic writes: “The study gives a detailed history of the device but offers little investigation of the failures reported in cold weather.” Two sentences later: “The device’s clearest flaw is that its battery loses capacity after repeated freezing.” What does the study fail to do?
o: provide any historical background
investigate the cold-weather failures sufficiently
prevent the battery from losing capacity
make the device work indefinitely in freezing conditions

exp.trans: 评论者说研究对设备历史讲得很详细，但对寒冷天气中的故障调查不足。后面说设备本身最明显的缺陷是反复结冰后电池容量下降。题目问study，因此答案是调查不足。
exp.structure: but连接两个对study的评价：history详细，failure investigation不足；后句The device’s clearest flaw把主语切到device。
exp.other: capacity 容量；freezing 冰冻环境；investigation 调查；critic 评论者。
exp.meaning: 并列句里一半信息就可以被题目抽出来做同义替换。不要因为答案没同时复述history和failure两侧就排除。
exp.rest: “provide any historical background”与detailed history相反；要求study去prevent battery loss或让device indefinitely work in freezing conditions，都是把研究报告与设备本身的职责混在一起。

questions.target: 反复信息 / 评价与比较
questions.q: The town newsletter repeatedly portrays residents who do not volunteer as “taking from the town without giving back.” Non-volunteers hear this judgment week after week. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: Every resident wants the newsletter to close.
Non-volunteers are repeatedly exposed to disapproving social judgments.
The newsletter never mentions non-volunteers.
Non-volunteers are generally less happy than volunteers.

exp.trans: 镇上的简报反复把不做志愿服务的居民描述成“只索取而不回馈”。他们周复一周听到这种评价。可以确认：他们持续接收到带否定意味的社会评价。
exp.structure: The town newsletter + portrays + residents + as引语。who do not volunteer修饰residents；第二句Non-volunteers + hear + this judgment，this judgment回指前文负面描述，week after week强调反复。
exp.other: newsletter 简报；volunteer 做志愿服务；give back 回馈；disapproving 不赞同的；judgment 评价。
exp.meaning: 带否定意味的评价即使没有直接辱骂，也可以构成criticism。题文直接支持这种评价持续存在，不提供两个群体幸福水平的比较。
exp.rest: Every resident扩大到全部居民并猜测态度；never mentions与反复描述无志愿服务者矛盾；generally less happy把受评价的处境扩大成群体幸福比较，没有比较数据或明确陈述。

questions.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

causal-role-direction.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
causal-role-direction.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

causal-role-direction.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension made firms miss the earlier deadline.
The later participation figures caused the council to extend the round.
The missed deadline prompted an extension; its effect on later participation is still unknown.
The earlier deadline was introduced in response to the extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: The extension made...让下一轮的措施反过来造成先前错过期限；later participation figures不存在已测量数据，不能成为依据；earlier deadline ... in response to the extension把较早规则与后来的回应倒置。

paragraph-scope-attitude.q: A passage first notes that friends strongly influence exercise habits. In its final paragraph, however, it says a city program that deliberately groups inactive residents with athletes 'rarely produces lasting change.' What does the final paragraph suggest about the program's use of peer influence?
o: Its effect is uncertain or doubtful.
Its influence on behavior is necessarily profound.
It is clearly harmful to friendship networks.
It succeeds because peer influence is strong.

exp.trans: 文章先承认朋友会强烈影响锻炼习惯；但末段说，城市刻意把不运动者与运动者配组的项目很少产生持久变化。因此，项目利用同伴影响的成效值得怀疑。
exp.structure: first notes...给背景；In its final paragraph, however锁定观点转折；a city program是末段被评价对象，rarely produces lasting change是评价核心。
exp.other: deliberately 刻意地；inactive 不活跃的；lasting 持久的；peer influence 同伴影响。
exp.meaning: 不要把前文对自然影响力的强度评价，直接搬到末段对政策/项目有效性的评价。
exp.rest: “necessarily profound”把“同伴影响本身强”偷换成“这个项目效果深远”；“clearly harmful”加入原文没有的危害判断；“it succeeds”又与rarely produces lasting change相反。

unpretentious.q: Despite her fame, the author washed dishes with the volunteers and asked for no special treatment. Her manner was ___.
o: unpredictable
hostile
unpretentious
perplexing

exp.trans: 尽管很有名，这位作家还是和志愿者一起洗碗，没有要求任何特殊待遇。她为人不摆架子。
exp.structure: 第一句主干：the author（主语）+ washed / asked（并列谓语）；dishes是washed的宾语，for no special treatment是asked后的介词短语。Despite her fame是让步状语。第二句：Her manner + was + unpretentious。
exp.other: despite 尽管；fame 名气；volunteer 志愿者；special treatment 特殊待遇。
exp.meaning: unpretentious表示朴实、不自命不凡，描述作风而非能否预测。
exp.rest: unpredictable：无法预测的，常搭配weather或behaviour；这里没有反复无常的线索。hostile：敌对的，常用be hostile to；与合作洗碗不符。perplexing：令人困惑的，常修饰question或situation；这里强调不摆架子。

unpretentious.q: On the same phone, the app sometimes opens instantly and sometimes takes a full minute. Its response time is ___.
o: unpretentious
unpredictable
constant
reliable

exp.trans: 在同一部手机上，这个应用有时马上打开，有时却要整整一分钟。它的响应时间难以预测。
exp.structure: the app是主语；opens和takes是并列谓语，sometimes...and sometimes...形成对比。第二句：Its response time（主语）+ is（系动词）+ unpredictable（表语）。
exp.other: instantly 立刻；a full minute 整整一分钟；response time 响应时间；constant 恒定的。
exp.meaning: unpredictable来自predict，表示难以预测；这里说性能表现忽快忽慢。
exp.rest: unpretentious：朴实、不摆架子的，常修饰person/style，不表示快慢无法预测。constant：恒定的，与忽快忽慢相反。reliable：可靠的，常用reliable information/service，不能概括这里不稳定的时间表现。

point.q:
Even after I explained the joke twice, my brother still missed the point.
missed the point 在这里表示什么？
o: 仍然怀念以前的笑话
仍然没明白笑话的关键
忘记了一个标点符号
没赶上兄弟聚会

exp.trans: 即使我把这个笑话解释了两遍，我弟弟仍然没有明白其中的关键。
exp.structure: 主句：my brother（主语）+ missed（谓语）+ the point（宾语）。after从句：I + explained + the joke；twice修饰explained。even强调即便已经解释过，结果仍如此。
exp.other: joke 笑话；twice 两次；still 仍然；explain 解释。
exp.meaning: miss the point整体表示没领会关键、没明白意思，不能把miss机械地译成怀念。
exp.rest: miss sb可表示想念某人，但miss the point不是这一义项。标点符号一般是punctuation mark，不是这里的point。miss a meeting可表示错过聚会，但原句没有meeting；brother是主语，不是被错过的活动。

point.target: point / there is no point in doing
point.q:
With the last bus already gone, there was no point in waiting at the stop.
point 在这里最接近：
o: 联合会
尖端
分数
意义、用处

exp.trans: 末班车已经开走了，继续在车站等也没有意义。
exp.structure: 主干：there was no point in waiting at the stop，是there be存在句。With the last bus already gone补充原因背景。简单句The last bus was already gone → 去掉was，用with + 名词 + 状态补语压缩。
exp.other: last bus 末班车；already 已经；be gone 已经离开、不在了；bus stop 公交站。
exp.meaning: there is no point in doing sth：做某事没有意义；point不是物理位置上的点。
exp.rest: 联合会常用federation/association，与句意无关。尖端可用the point of a needle，必须是具体物体的尖端。分数可说score three points，但这里不是计分语境。

point.q: “Residents have a point: the evening bus reaches the station after the last train has left.” What does have a point convey?
o: 居民的意见有道理，时刻表提供了理由。
居民已经同意公交运营方的安排。
公交晚到导致火车晚点。
居民指出了一个新的候车地点。

exp.trans: “居民说得有道理：晚班公交抵达车站时，末班火车已经离开了。”问题问have a point表达什么。
exp.structure: Residents是主语，have是谓语，a point是宾语。冒号后的the evening bus + reaches + the station给出理由；after从句的has left表示火车先已离开。
exp.other: resident 居民；station 车站；the last train 末班火车；timetable 时刻表。
exp.meaning: have a point表示某人的意见有道理或值得考虑。这里肯定的是意见所据的理由，不是找到一个地点；与miss the point不同，这次是抓到了有效理由。
exp.rest: “同意运营方”加入了原文没有的立场，且解释的是时刻衔接不便。“导致火车晚点”倒置了时间信息：火车已走，并未晚点。“新的候车地点”把抽象的意见或道理误当具体地点。

scope-role-match.target: 题干对象 / 评价对象匹配
scope-role-match.skill: 关键词相似前先核对主语
scope-role-match.q: A review says: “The report contains pages of anecdotes and too little analysis of why small firms avoid the subsidy.” It later adds: “The subsidy’s most serious weakness is that participation falls once temporary bonuses end.” If asked what the report fails to do, which answer is best?
o: explain adequately why small firms avoid the subsidy
produce participation that lasts after bonuses end
remove all anecdotes from the discussion
prove that temporary bonuses never increase participation

exp.trans: 评论先说报告轶事过多，却没有充分分析小企业为何避开补贴；后面又说补贴本身最严重的问题是奖金结束后参与度下降。若题干问“报告没做到什么”，答案应回到报告本身。
exp.structure: 第一句The report是被评价对象；第二句The subsidy’s most serious weakness把评价对象切换成补贴政策。题干再次锁定the report。
exp.other: anecdote 轶事；subsidy 补贴；participation 参与度；temporary bonus 临时奖励。
exp.meaning: 看到most serious weakness之类强信号不能直接选，先检查这个weakness属于谁。正确选项可以只改写并列句中的一侧，不必覆盖整句所有批评。
exp.rest: “produce participation that lasts...”描述的是subsidy的持久效果，不是report的写作缺陷；“remove all anecdotes”把too many夸大成必须全部删除；“prove...never”加入绝对化的never和原文没有的证明要求。

social-message-inference.target: 社会评价 / 信息影响
social-message-inference.q: A workplace culture repeatedly celebrates employees who stay late, and workers who leave on time are often reminded that “real commitment means sacrifice.” What is most safely suggested?
o: Workers who leave on time are formally punished every day.
The culture may make some workers question whether they are committed enough.
Employees who stay late are always more productive.
Managers ignore workers who leave on time.

exp.trans: 一种职场文化反复赞美加班员工，而准时下班的人经常被提醒“真正的投入意味着牺牲”。最稳妥的推断是：这种文化可能让一些人怀疑自己是否足够投入。
exp.structure: 主句1：A workplace culture + celebrates + employees。who stay late修饰employees。主句2：workers who leave on time + are reminded + that从句。that从句给出被灌输的信息。题目要从这种持续信息推断心理影响，而不是擅自添加处罚事实。
exp.other: workplace culture 职场文化；commitment 投入/忠诚；sacrifice 牺牲；question whether 怀疑是否。
exp.meaning: 持续传递带否定意味的价值标准可以构成广义批评，不必出现直接人身侮辱。本题的具体线索支持自我评价可能受到影响，但不支持正式惩罚或跨群体满意度比较。
exp.rest: formally punished every day加入原文没有的正式处罚；always more productive把价值宣传偷换成生产率事实；ignore与“are often reminded”相反。

social-message-inference.target: 社会评价 / 信息影响
social-message-inference.q: At a school, the wall of honour lists only perfect test scores. A pupil who has improved greatly still asks, “Does my progress count if I never appear on that wall?” Which inference is best supported?
o: The pupil has been personally insulted by every teacher.
The display may lead the pupil to doubt the value of improvement without perfection.
The school has failed to display any test scores.
Every pupil with a perfect score has made greater progress.

exp.trans: 一所学校的荣誉墙只列满分成绩。一名进步很大的学生仍问：“如果我从未登上那面墙，我的进步还算数吗？”最稳妥的推断是：这种展示可能让他怀疑没有满分的进步是否有价值。
exp.structure: 第一句：the wall of honour + lists + only perfect test scores。第二句：A pupil + asks + 引语；who has improved greatly修饰pupil。引语里if从句给出没有上榜这一条件。学生的问题体现了对进步价值的怀疑。
exp.other: wall of honour 荣誉墙；perfect score 满分；progress 进步；count 有价值/算数。
exp.meaning: 持续传递带否定意味的价值标准可以构成广义批评，不必出现直接人身侮辱。本题的具体线索支持自我评价可能受到影响，但不支持正式惩罚或跨群体满意度比较。
exp.rest: personally insulted无直接侮辱证据，every teacher还扩大范围；failed to display any scores与列出满分矛盾；greater progress把最终成绩偷换成进步幅度。

social-message-inference.target: 社会信息 / 推断边界
social-message-inference.q: A shop’s guide calls replacing a worn battery “settling for yesterday’s technology.” It says nothing about whether a repaired phone would meet its owner’s needs. Which inference is best supported?
o: The guide judges repairs from owners’ reported dissatisfaction.
The guide compares replacements by how long they last.
The guide frames repair negatively without establishing that it fails to meet users’ needs.
The guide identifies a technical obstacle that prevents battery replacement.

exp.trans: 一家商店的指南把更换磨损的电池称为“将就使用过时技术”。它没有讨论修好的手机能否满足机主的需要。最有依据的推断是：它对维修附加了负面评价，却没有证明维修无法满足需要。
exp.structure: 主句A shop’s guide + calls + replacing a worn battery + 引语，call把维修描述成某种选择。It指guide；whether从句是about的补足内容，a repaired phone是该从句主语，would meet是谓语。
exp.other: worn 磨损的；settle for 将就接受；battery 电池；meet someone’s needs 满足某人的需要。
exp.meaning: 区分价值标签与功能证据。“过时”是指南附加的评价标签，不能直接升级为对实际需要是否得到满足的证据，也不必出现人身侮辱才有否定性信息。
exp.rest: reported dissatisfaction补出未报告的用户调查；how long they last偷换成使用寿命比较；technical obstacle把负面描述变成无法换电池的技术原因，三者都没有文本依据。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, only a small share of those who remain receive an offer.
By contrast, the building was completed twenty years earlier.
For example, the company sells products in four countries.
In conclusion, this proves that all interviews are unnecessary.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: By contrast需要真正对立关系；For example需要前文有待举例的一般命题；In conclusion过早收束，而且all interviews are unnecessary也超出前文。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。
